$comment: The banner's What's New list, newest first: the two to four things a returning user should notice, not a changelog. `reviewedFor` is the release this list was last looked at for. A release can't ship until it equals package.json's version (scripts/check-whats-new.mjs, run by `npm test` and by release.yml before anything builds), so every release, patches included, is a deliberate look at this list. If nothing new is worth a line, bumping `reviewedFor` alone is the answer. `since` is the release an entry arrived in. `cmd` is shown in the accent colour.

items.text: Save to Cargo with no app attached — it lands on your next app open
Several privateer -p runs at once no longer sign each other out
A reply cut off at the output limit picks back up on its own
Chat channels as a login service: privateer channels install
